templates.title: FCaptcha
templates.name: fcaptcha
templates.description: Self-hosted CAPTCHA widget and server-side token verification for web forms. Source: https://github.com/WebDecoy/FCaptcha

env.name: FCAPTCHA_SECRET
env.label: Signing secret (required)
env.description: Generate with openssl rand -hex 32. Save this value for redeployments.

env.name: FCAPTCHA_VERIFY_SECRET
env.label: Verification secret (required for app integration)
env.description: Run openssl rand -hex 32 again for a different value. Use this value only in your application backend.

env.name: FCAPTCHA_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES
env.label: Allowed website hostnames
env.description: For public use, list the hostnames where the widget appears, separated by commas, without schemes or ports.

env.name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
env.label: Trusted reverse proxies
env.description: For an HTTPS reverse proxy, list only the proxy IPs or CIDRs trusted to set forwarded client information.

templates.note: Generate the two secrets before deploying. Open http://<docker-host>:8300/demo/ from your private network to try the widget. This single instance uses in-memory state and has no login or required volume. Limit access to the published port to your private network or reverse proxy. Configure HTTPS and read the hardening guide before public use. Use the verification secret exclusively in your application backend.
